title: DapperFL: Domain Adaptive Federated Learning with Model Fusion Pruning for Edge Devices

layout.note: A light-blue band at the top holds the server, the aggregated model and the red degradation notes; a row of three equal lilac device cards sits below; solid and dotted arrows cross the gap between them in the same three columns.

lesson: A motivation figure can show the problem as one numbered round: a server band over client cards, a missing return arrow and a red tag on the failed client, and stacked thumbnails that differ per client to show data shift.
